capturePolicy.rule: Any explicit Product Owner decision that locks, accepts, changes, supersedes, freezes, keeps, or forbids a behaviour must be reflected in this lockset before the next implementation is considered complete.
capturePolicy.supersession: Never silently delete an accepted requirement. Mark the old requirement SUPERSEDED and point supersededBy to the replacement requirement ID.

releaseGate.rule: A release candidate is not sealed unless lockset verification, automated CI, the required real-browser gate, and required physical acceptance are all green.

noChangeBoundaries: NGAMSOI mark geometry except by explicit Product Owner approval
REKOD #7 redesign, daily aggregation and daily approval redesign
Print semantics and official daily output aggregation

requirements.title: Workspace semantics
requirements.statement: CATAT captures one atomic work observation; AKTIVITI is ongoing/continuation work only; REKOD is saved/history and its #7 redesign remains out of scope; SEMAK remains the reviewer workspace. Backend workspace ids remain NEW/OPEN/RECORDS/APPROVALS.

requirements.title: Atomic Site Diary identity
requirements.statement: Post-save identity is canonical site_diary_id/siteDiaryId only. activityId is never a fallback. Missing Site Diary identity fails closed.

requirements.title: Daily work state and Actual Start authority
requirements.statement: Daily snapshot is MULA/LAKSANA/SIAP with same-day start-and-complete support where implemented. MSP Planned Start is never Actual Start. Known Start is requested only when Actual Start is unknown and required by the workflow.

requirements.title: Activity transition and immutable snapshot semantics
requirements.statement: Activity lifecycle remains New -> In Progress -> Completed. A new Activity defaults to MULA; MULA sets Actual Start to the diary date and transitions to In Progress. LAKSANA may represent first system capture of already-ongoing work only with known Actual Start when not already known. SIAP requires known Actual Start and transitions to Completed. MULA_DAN_SIAP represents same-day start and completion. Historical Site Diary work status is an independent daily snapshot and must never be derived from mutable current Activity status.

requirements.title: Official weather authority
requirements.statement: Official CATAT weather is ELOK/HUJAN only. Historical resolution is hourly, supports zero or multiple rain intervals, merges consecutive buckets, keeps distinct periods separate, and preserves provider provenance. Supervisor is final authority through SAH/UBAH.

requirements.title: Forecast separation and smart rain entry
requirements.statement: Header weather is operational forecast only and never writes official Page 1 weather. For same-day + Sela hujan, default to the current one-hour bucket, choose the next available hour if already represented, and handle 23:00 to 24:00. Backdated entries prioritise unrepresented provider hourly evidence and must not fabricate current-time evidence.

requirements.title: Weather provider operational contract
requirements.statement: Visual Crossing historical evidence uses the canonical site point 3.983583, 101.061639 and timezone Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Provider responses are cached by site/date, historical evidence remains hourly, and VISUAL_CROSSING_API_KEY remains server-only. Live forecast and historical evidence remain separate semantics.

requirements.title: Workforce observation authority
requirements.statement: TRE recommendation chips appear when available and search is secondary. Selecting a trade creates observed B/BB/A counts at zero. WRE/TRE never auto-populates actual attendance. Continuation may prefill latest prior observed workforce. Worker/trade hardhat glyph remains part of the accepted scanability grammar.

requirements.title: Workforce tactile matrix
requirements.statement: Observed workforce entry preserves the tactile B/BB/A matrix, per-trade counts and live JUMLAH totals. New CATAT starts without the old nine static trade rows; continuation may prefill prior observed workforce and edit preserves exact saved workforce.

requirements.title: Working time interaction
requirements.statement: Normal working time defaults to 08:00 to 17:00 with product-owned 24-hour display. Native time controls appear only when the user chooses to edit.

requirements.title: Responsive navigation and selected state
requirements.statement: Wide desktop uses labelled collapsible sidebar; 768-1199 uses compact persistent rail with overlay expansion; phone uses bottom navigation. Responsive safety overrides stored preference. Selected state retains both aria-selected and data-selected and desktop/mobile indicators must not leak into each other.

requirements.title: Operational header
requirements.statement: Core header facts are current revision, remaining days, day number, and current date-time. Forecast is secondary; loading/unavailable forecast must not become a first-class metric.

requirements.title: Responsive header safety
requirements.statement: Across wide desktop, half-window and phone, the four core operational facts remain readable without clipping or ellipsis. Forecast may appear only as a secondary micro-signal when usable and must not displace, duplicate or outrank the four core facts.

requirements.title: Four-fact operational dashboard authority
requirements.statement: Across wide desktop, half-window and phone the user-facing operational dashboard contains exactly four facts: PROGRAM KERJA, TINGGAL, SEMASA and RAMALAN CUACA. HARI KE is removed from the dashboard. TINGGAL combines remaining days with the HARI unit and current completion target, for example 207 HARI · SIAP 31/03/27. Wide and half-window use one four-column row; phone uses a two-by-two grid with the same four facts. All four facts remain readable without clipping, ellipsis or horizontal overflow.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of the exact four-fact dashboard at wide, half-window and phone.

requirements.title: Operational overflow safety
requirements.statement: Wide desktop, half-window and phone operational workspaces must not introduce horizontal page overflow. Responsive navigation and overlays must preserve the working width rather than pushing the workspace off-canvas.

requirements.title: Single explicit operational Spine
requirements.statement: Operational order is SUMBER to HARIAN to TAPAK to CUACA to PEKERJA to CATATAN to SIMPAN on exactly one visual axis. States are complete/current/upcoming driven by explicit data-spine-state. Legacy structural selectors must not own state or render a second rail. Completed nodes use one CI-like green success treatment.

requirements.title: Sharp-sleek geometry
requirements.statement: Operational cards, inputs, selects, textareas, buttons, segmented controls, toast and header use sharp sleek geometry. Only semantically circular nodes and avatars may remain circular.

requirements.title: One visual owner per concern
requirements.statement: Each operational visual concern has one active authority. A new visual authority must retire or neutralise the superseded authority. Indefinite override-on-override generations are forbidden.

requirements.title: VO/APK layering
requirements.statement: VO/APK modal must be topmost, not clipped, and not trapped by SUMBER or Spine stacking contexts.

requirements.title: Post-save confirmation
requirements.statement: Save success must not cause timer-driven reset or aggressive scroll. Confirmation persists long enough to act, uses Disimpan as success hero, Kena boh! Ngamsoi. as secondary brand copy, and keeps Tunjuk Rekod and Tambah Aktiviti actions.

requirements.title: Frozen NGAMSOI mark
requirements.statement: NGAMSOI mark geometry is frozen at the accepted master and must not be altered by F4.5 reconciliation or cutover work.

requirements.title: F4.5 no-change boundaries
requirements.statement: F4.5 work must not redesign REKOD #7, print, approval, domain/Engine ownership, database/migrations, RLS/RBAC, authentication/security, audit/history, or Programme/Revision authority.

requirements.title: Genuine production-runtime browser gate
requirements.statement: CI browser acceptance exercises the already-built production runtime. CI must not be made green through force-click, skipped assertions, relaxed geometry or overflow thresholds, hiding/moving dev overlays, arbitrary timeout inflation, added retries, or equivalent evidence weakening.

requirements.title: Production-safe acceptance fixture boundary
requirements.statement: The F4.5 real-browser fixture is owned by Playwright test code, runs against the already-built next start runtime, uses a strict method/path API allowlist, fails closed on unexpected application API calls, uses zero retries, and does not add or enable any production application auth bypass, preview flag, test route, provider override or live mutable external dependency.

requirements.title: Seal requires physical acceptance
requirements.statement: Automated CI green is necessary but not sufficient. Required physical wide desktop, half-window and phone acceptance must be green before F4.5 visual seal.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance at required viewports before seal

requirements.title: Legacy automatic post-save reset
requirements.statement: An earlier accepted F4.5 contract used automatic soft reset, retained diary-date/weather context, scrolled back to CATAT start and removed post-save actions. This is superseded by the later persistent confirmation contract with explicit Tunjuk Rekod and Tambah Aktiviti actions and no aggressive reset/scroll.

requirements.title: Completion overlay
requirements.statement: Successful Save presents a focused completion overlay/dialog in the accepted VO/APK modal visual family: focused hierarchy, backdrop, topmost presentation and sharp-sleek geometry. It is a completion checkpoint, not a low-priority toast. Disimpan is the success hero; Kena boh! Ngamsoi. remains secondary brand copy. Tunjuk Rekod and Tambah Aktiviti remain required actions. There is no timer-driven disappearance/reset, no aggressive page movement and specifically no automatic scroll-to-top after Save. The overlay comes to the user's current viewport and persists until meaningful user interaction/dismissal. Canonical site_diary_id/siteDiaryId authority and save/domain/database/auth semantics remain unchanged.

requirements.title: Completion Seal
requirements.statement: Successful Save presents a restrained ceremonial Completion Seal in the current viewport. Disimpan remains the success hero and Kena boh! Ngamsoi. remains secondary brand copy. Tunjuk Rekod and Tambah Aktiviti remain required actions and an explicit × close/dismiss button is required. The completion symbol uses the same visual DNA as a completed Spine node: circular green success node with check, scaled appropriately for the seal. The overlay remains topmost with backdrop, sharp-sleek geometry and bounded accessible keyboard focus. There is no timer-driven disappearance, no automatic scroll-to-top or other Save-triggered page movement. Dismissal closes only the overlay, never undoes the saved state, and SIMPAN remains the completed final Spine checkpoint. A short non-blocking resolve transition is allowed; confetti and decorative noise are forbidden. Canonical site_diary_id/siteDiaryId, persistence, auth and domain semantics remain unchanged.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of Completion Seal, close action, completed-node visual continuity and viewport stability.

requirements.title: End-to-end Spine geometry
requirements.statement: Operational order remains exactly SUMBER -> HARIAN -> TAPAK -> CUACA -> PEKERJA -> CATATAN -> SIMPAN on exactly one visual axis. SIMPAN is the official final Spine checkpoint; the rail visibly and intentionally reaches it and SIMPAN must not appear outside or disconnected from the operational journey. Phone SUMBER aligns to its actual SUMBER section anchor without overshooting above it; phone SIMPAN aligns to the final Save section. The rail terminates intentionally at the final SIMPAN node without premature stop or visual tail/overshoot below it. Node placement derives from section geometry/semantic wrappers, not fragile arbitrary offsets fitting one viewport. States remain complete/current/upcoming driven by explicit data-spine-state; legacy structural selectors must not own state or render a second rail. Completed nodes retain one CI-like green success treatment.

enforcement.note: Pending final Product Owner physical acceptance of one axis, section-derived node alignment and intentional SIMPAN termination at required viewports.

requirements.title: Tactical Pulse Bar
requirements.statement: The flat/equal-cell table-like mini-dashboard failed physical acceptance. Its locked replacement is OPTION 1 - TACTICAL PULSE BAR. PROGRAM KERJA, TINGGAL, HARI KE and SEMASA remain the four first-class core facts, readable at wide, half and phone without clipping or ellipsis. Project identity remains clearly above/with the pulse system. Operational facts form a connected tactical pulse system, not a generic flat table. Preserve sharp-sleek geometry and disciplined NGAMSOI visual grammar: orange tactical accent/micro-rule/restrained motif, strong scan hierarchy and premium operational feel. Motif supports meaning/readability and never becomes decoration noise.

requirements.title: Four-fact Tactical Pulse
requirements.statement: The Tactical Pulse remains the accepted dashboard visual family but its user-facing content is exactly PROGRAM KERJA, TINGGAL, SEMASA and RAMALAN CUACA. HARI KE is removed. PROGRAM KERJA must not repeat its label inside its own value. TINGGAL presents the remaining number with HARI and the current SIAP target. Wide and half-window render one four-column row; phone renders the same four facts as a two-by-two grid. All four facts share one connected tactical frame and border grammar, preserve sharp-sleek NGAMSOI hierarchy, and remain readable without clipping, ellipsis or horizontal overflow.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of the four-fact Tactical Pulse at wide, half-window and phone.

requirements.title: Tactical weather presentation
requirements.statement: This supplements and must not weaken F45-WX-001/002/003. Weather on this surface is operational FORECAST only and never writes or mutates official CATAT/Page-1 weather; provider/domain authority remains unchanged. WIDE >=1200: usable forecast is a compact secondary weather pulse at the end of the Tactical Pulse Bar. HALF 768-1199: four core facts remain dominant and weather moves to a compact secondary strip rather than crowding them. PHONE: four core facts remain dominant and weather is a compact secondary strip BELOW the core pulse, never competing with SEMASA or causing horizontal overflow. Usable dry forecast shows a concise dry/weather signal and temperature when available. Usable rain forecast shows a concise rain signal/probability and next rain window when available. Loading/unavailable remains visually secondary, never becomes a first-class metric and must not change or break core pulse geometry.

requirements.title: Forecast dashboard presentation
requirements.statement: Operational forecast remains separate from official CATAT/Page-1 weather and never writes or mutates official weather. In the dashboard it is presented as the fourth fact labelled RAMALAN CUACA and uses the same tactical frame/border grammar as PROGRAM KERJA, TINGGAL and SEMASA. It is not a detached sidecar or strip. Green accent/line is forbidden for forecast because green is reserved for completed/success semantics. Dry, rain, loading and unavailable states retain identical dashboard geometry; usable dry may show concise condition and temperature, usable rain may show concise rain/probability/window, and missing values must never be fabricated.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of forecast parity and stable states at all required viewports.

requirements.title: Operational user-facing language
requirements.statement: Operational copy must speak in the user's field context rather than implementation terminology. SUMBER uses the same orange-dash sub-header grammar as HARIAN/TAPAK/CUACA/PEKERJA/CATATAN. Same-day/manual ELOK does not show redundant Manual or Manual · Tiada hujan copy. Historical/provider-assisted weather uses Cadangan cuaca before supervisor confirmation and Disahkan after SAH/UBAH while provider metadata stays secondary. The Mula sebenar helper reads Tarikh sebenar kerja mula di tapak. The redundant green Mula + Siap note is removed while underlying MULA_DAN_SIAP semantics remain unchanged.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of the user-facing language and SUMBER sub-header grammar.

requirements.title: Immediate executor semantics and deferred stakeholder identity
requirements.statement: The user-facing CATAT field labelled SKOP is replaced by PELAKSANA. Immediate F4.5 choices are Kontraktor Utama and NSC without changing existing persistence/domain semantics. Deterministic stakeholder identity is deferred to future project-scoped membership using PERSON -> PROJECT MEMBERSHIP -> ORGANISATION -> PROJECT ROLE; stakeholder role must not be inferred from a global user profile. F4.5 must not introduce database, migration, RLS/RBAC or authentication changes for this future direction.

enforcement.note: Pending Product Owner physical acceptance of PELAKSANA wording and immediate choices.

requirements.title: Legacy five-block responsive header composition
requirements.statement: An earlier F4.5 contract treated forecast as a fifth peer header block and specified desktop five-block and phone 3+2 composition. Later physical acceptance superseded that geometry.

requirements.title: Legacy rounded operational geometry
requirements.statement: An earlier visual preference allowed moderate consistent radii. Later physical acceptance explicitly superseded it with sharp-sleek geometry across operational surfaces.

requirements.title: Completion-only green authority
requirements.statement: Green is reserved for genuine completed/success semantics only. Decorative, tactical, progress, header and forecast divider/underline/accent treatments must not use green. Completed Spine nodes and genuine saved/completed success states retain the accepted green treatment. This requirement strengthens recurrence control without changing NGAMSOI mark geometry.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance must confirm no stray green dashboard/header/forecast lines at wide, half-window and phone.

requirements.title: Single SUMBER hierarchy
requirements.statement: The CATAT source area has one visible SUMBER section heading using the shared orange-dash sub-header grammar. Selected-source and source-navigation content must not render a second redundant SUMBER heading. MSP and VO / APK labels remain allowed only where they identify source type or selected-source metadata. Existing source, revision and Spine semantics remain unchanged.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance must confirm a single non-redundant SUMBER hierarchy in selected and expanded source states.

requirements.title: Concise field-language and same-day guidance
requirements.statement: Operational copy remains field-context language. The Mula sebenar helper is exactly Tarikh kerja mula di tapak. The HARIAN status control provides lightweight guidance that MULA and SIAP may be selected together when work starts and finishes on the same diary day, using Boleh pilih MULA + SIAP jika kerja mula dan siap hari ini. Do not reintroduce technical MSP helper language or the redundant green Mula + Siap pseudo-success note. Existing MULA_DAN_SIAP lifecycle semantics remain unchanged.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance must confirm concise Mula sebenar copy and discoverable MULA + SIAP guidance without visual noise.

requirements.title: Stable saved receipt after Completion Seal dismissal
requirements.statement: F45-SAVE-003 Completion Seal semantics remain required. Pressing × dismisses the ceremonial overlay only and never undoes or mutates the saved record. After dismissal CATAT must settle into an explicit stable saved receipt state at/with the final SIMPAN checkpoint, clearly communicating Disimpan and keeping Tunjuk Rekod and Tambah Aktiviti available. The saved observation remains immutable; disabled editor controls must not be presented as the primary post-dismiss experience or leave a misleading no-entry/hung affordance. × does not reset, create a new activity, navigate or auto-scroll. Tambah Aktiviti explicitly starts the next CATAT observation and Tunjuk Rekod explicitly opens saved/history. Canonical Site Diary identity, persistence, auth and domain semantics remain unchanged.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance must exercise Save -> Completion Seal -> × -> stable saved receipt -> both next actions.

requirements.title: Dialog close-control geometry parity
requirements.statement: Completion Seal and VO/APK dialog × controls use the same sharp square bounded geometry family with equal horizontal/vertical visual padding, optically centred glyph and balanced top/right inset. The control must not create an oversized right-side gap. Rounded close controls are forbidden.

enforcement.note: Product Owner physical acceptance must confirm visually balanced × geometry on Completion Seal and VO/APK dialogs.

requirements.title: Deterministic forecast availability messaging
requirements.statement: F45-WX-001/002/003/005 remain protected. Live RAMALAN CUACA uses the authenticated /api/weather/site?mode=forecast path and Visual Crossing authority. Real live data requires an authenticated session, server-side VISUAL_CROSSING_API_KEY, valid site configuration and a successful provider request. Production must not add client-side keys, fake live weather or preview/provider bypasses. Loading, unavailable, dry and rain states retain the same dashboard geometry. The unavailable user-facing copy is Ramalan belum tersedia rather than generic Tiada data. Real-browser CI uses its production-safe fixture and must not depend on a mutable live provider.

enforcement.note: Physical acceptance of live provider data may use a correctly configured local/server environment; missing provider configuration must show deterministic unavailable copy.

requirements.title: Round 3 recurrence proving
requirements.statement: For this remediation cycle, proving must explicitly cover recurring physical findings instead of relying on generic green CI. Before first PROVE, recon/pre-flight must inspect legacy CSS ownership/specificity, duplicated dashboard labels and post-save lifecycle state. Browser evidence must assert no duplicate PROGRAM KERJA label/value copy, no forbidden green dashboard/forecast accents, deterministic Save -> × -> saved receipt behaviour, and robust close-control geometry where measurable. No assertion weakening, retries, force-clicks or equivalent green-by-bypass are permitted.
